fields.label: Grantees

columns.label: User
columns.help: Empty user text denotes a native anonymous account; supply its host separately.

fields.help: Separate native account components preserve literal quotes, dots and @ characters.

fields.label: Scope
fields.help: All account privileges is REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES, GRANT OPTION. Library grants do not imply an available closed execution runtime.

fields.label: Privileges
fields.help: Native keyword or installed dynamic privilege per row. Column lists apply to table/view SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE or REFERENCES; MySQL validates scope and availability.

fields.label: With grant option
fields.help: GRANT only. To revoke delegation, select the GRANT OPTION privilege.

fields.label: If it exists
fields.help: REVOKE only; retain native warnings for absent grants.

fields.label: Ignore unknown users
fields.help: REVOKE only; the native statement determines partial results and warnings.

fields.label: Grant as user
fields.help: GRANT AS is native global-privilege delegation only.

fields.label: Grantor roles
fields.help: GRANT AS only. A selected/excluded role set uses the separate native account grid.

fields.label: Confirmation
fields.help: Type the selected target display name when required.

notes: Native MySQL9.7 pure/C and authenticated plan/apply qualify typed account tuples, scoped column lists, dynamic privileges, proxy accounts, global GRANT AS role modes, partial revokes and native warnings/errors. Shared rendering and family diff round trips remain pending.
